# Output Format Instructions

All generated Markdown files must be readable, structured, and reviewable.

## Rules

- Use stable IDs: CAP-001, EPIC-001, STORY-001, GAP-001, Q-001.
- Use tables for summaries.
- Use headings for details.
- Do not produce only bullet lists when structured sections are required.
- Use "Not applicable" instead of leaving required sections empty.
- Use "Not specified in BRS" when the BRS does not contain required information.
- Do not claim final certainty where the BRS is ambiguous.

## File Naming

Use these output files:

```text
/output/01-extracted-capabilities.md
/output/02-candidate-epics.md
/output/03-candidate-stories.md
/output/04-backlog-review.md
/output/05-github-issues.md
/output/06-traceability-matrix.md
```
